items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury; McVay says not making great progress and team being cautious, not long-term but Week 3 status in doubt.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP; McVay candid on lack of progress and need for time to heal soft-tissue issue.
items.implication: Likely misses Week 3 vs DEN; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: Expanded routes/targets for Davante Adams (prior 42% tgt share sans Nacua).

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs after Grade 1 strain; sources previously expected multi-game absence.
items.implication: Highly likely OUT vs IND; low play chance.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for Dalton Schultz (30% routes, 28% share last week).

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after knee surgery (MCL/meniscus; ACL intact); out for regular season, possible playoff return door left open.
items.implication: Giants QB carousel; impacts Nabers/offense long-term.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI results; expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.implication: Should be full go; must-start if cleared.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%); produced 8-195-2 vs NYG and prior big game without him.
items.why: High route/target share and production in Nacua absences; McVay notes limited Nacua progress.
items.implication: Adams elite WR1 upside if Nacua out again vs DEN.

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring Aug 20 joint practice; aggravated after 5-150-1 first half W1, hasn't practiced full since; Ravens to Brazil this week.
items.why: Lingering aggravation + travel; consecutive DNPs reported.
items.implication: Unlikely Week 3 vs DAL in Brazil; monitor flight/practice.

items.text: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks placed on IR after core muscle surgery; out at least 6 weeks.
items.why: Surgery for core injury from Week 2.
items.implication: Out multiple weeks; Chuba Hubbard locked as lead back.

items.text: Comprehensive hurt list: QBs/WRs/TEs include Nacua, Collins, Bowers, AJ Brown, Flowers, Daniels, Williams, Dart, Reed, Murray, Pierce, Pittman, Goedert; RBs meh committees Brooks/Dowdle/Mason.
items.implication: Monitor practice reports for status changes and rolebounds.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs/backups and role expansion for healthy teammates.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak Cowboys run D + prop line.
items.opportunity: Volume + efficiency vs bottom rush D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86); PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share sans Collins; IND 4th-most TE yards allowed).
items.implication: Olave WR1/2; Schultz TE1 if Collins out.
items.opportunity: Target share and yards vs soft Ds.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs) and Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there).
items.why: Declining/role-limited usage + tough or unclear matchups.
items.implication: Sit or fade; Henderson closing gap on Stevenson.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead W3 despite data.

items.text: Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total) and Rome Odunze vs PHI (12% tgt share, tough aDOT, Quinyon Mitchell, low team total).
items.why: Poor matchups + low volume/team totals (Daniels injury context for McLaurin).

items.text: Fact: Post-Stevenson fumble, Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. London averages 20+ PPR, 35% tgt share, 97 ypg in 12 career games with Penix.
items.why: Snap/touch data and historical Penix-London production.
items.implication: Henderson rising; London smash with healthy Penix (TNF already showed).
items.opportunity: Role expansion/snaps for Henderson; high tgt share London.
